column4: cleat#3168/#3177: this test loops pluginDepsBackends() the same way TestRemovingARuleThatIsNotThereIsReportedByEveryDialect already does, so its postgres and mssql t.Run arms skip under multi-db/mysql (CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL set, the other two not) exactly as that sibling test's do -- but that sibling has no dedicated line, so this is a new broad-line contribution rather than a bump of an existing specific one. 2 skips: one subtest per non-MySQL dialect.
same test, same reason, for multi-db/mssql (CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL set, the other two not): the postgres and mysql arms skip here instead.

engine-race.yml runs ./engine/... on PostgreSQL only, so this test's mysql and mssql arms skip here too. Measured with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set: go test ./engine/ -run '^TestRemovingARoutingRuleByNamingADifferentWorkflowIsNotFound$' -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports 2.

dialect-gated: same test as the test-go/engine line above (byte-identical regex, per check-skip-ledger-engine-coverage.py); the cluster job runs ./engine/... too, with CLEAT_TEST_DB (postgres) set and no CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL or CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL. Found red in cleat-review's falsification of #3177; this line and the test-go/engine line above are the fix.
